source: A generative or masked-language-model objective trains hidden states to support token prediction and the model’s internal computation. A retrieval embedding objective instead cares about pairwise geometry: relevant texts should score higher than irrelevant texts under a chosen similarity rule.
zh: 生成或掩码语言模型目标训练隐藏状态以支持标记预测和模型的内部计算。相反，检索嵌入目标关心成对几何：在选定的相似性规则下，相关文本应该比不相关文本得分更高。
